name: chordino.js
description: Chord detection in the browser: the Chordino Vamp plugin compiled to WebAssembly, with a Web Worker for recordings and an AudioWorklet for live input
author: Francimar Alves <mazinsw@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: tsc -b src/js && esbuild src/js/chord-worker.ts src/js/chord-processor.ts --outdir=build --out-extension:.js=.mjs --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify && cp src/js/chordino.d.mts build/
